H1 is partially supported: source-target similarity is informative, but it is not sufficient as a standalone explanation of transfer success. The pooled site-level association is weak and not significant (Spearman rho = 0.067, p = 0.136) and is in the expected direction (higher similarity -> larger fixed-transfer gain), while similarity diagnostics together account for 15% of the selector's permutation importance and are used as one of several selector inputs.
